data.name: A Magical Honor "The Race to Rescue PFC Whiskers"
data.detailed_description:
Our story begins with the capture of our heroine's son, PFC Whiskers. He was engaged in a top-secret mission behind enemy lines. His Country, the land of Catsgetta, has promised to do everything they can to obtain his release. Top negotiators began the process of communicating with the enemy Government of Ratscotta. While in prison, the young PFC made friends with other inmates who provided him with a phone. He had to call his mom, Fawnish, first. This PFC's mom is not only beautiful but also an experienced combat veteran. Her abilities are not only limited to traditional weapons; she also has magical weapons with exceptional throwing skill! When hearing from her son, she swears she will be the one to rescue him from tyranny.

This game includes five large maps with lots of secret areas to find. The missions are varied and include many opportunities for forward advancement. The enemies are very skilled and come in all styles: melee, shooters, and magic attackers!
